# Information-adaptive market maker (generated by adaptive_mm.py; do not edit by hand)

Real Kalshi taker trades replayed against LMSR makers opened at the noon cutoff with the public forecast. Train 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-31, test to 2026-08-13; each maker's b0, fee and kappa are chosen on train days. Daily PnL in dollars for one six-bin event. Event-time PnL comes from fills within 15 minutes after a 1-minute knock-out or an hourly report. A counterfactual estimate, not realized PnL.

## Same settings for every maker

Each city uses fixed_close's train-day b0 and fee for all makers, and kappa 0.3 for the adaptive one, so a difference comes from the feature, not from tuning. Pooled: each city's daily gaps are divided by their own standard deviation, then all city-days are resampled.

## Caveats

- Replay: a real trade fills only if the maker would have been at least as good, at the taker's own price. Trades the maker would have attracted but Kalshi did not are missing, and traders might have reacted to these quotes.
- The live and adaptive makers act on the 1-minute reading from 5 minutes earlier, as a stand-in for the public 5-minute feed; a trader with a faster feed would do better, a slower one worse.
- Two months of train days choose 12 to 24 settings per maker; test results are the evidence.
